statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
Z86.73 indicates a personal history of ischemic heart disease
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
